title: Useful words and expressions
descriptionFa: کلمه‌های کوچیک ولی مهم مکالمه، پیشنهاد دادن، و واکنش نشون دادن.

words.example: Everyone thinks he's rich, but actually he has very little money.
words.tipFa: actually یعنی «در واقع»، نه «در حال حاضر». «الان» می‌شه now یا at the moment.

words.example: Is there anything else you need?
words.tipFa: بعد از something, anything, somewhere, who, what میاد: Who else is coming?

words.example: The drive to Isfahan takes around five hours.
words.tipFa: about هم همین معنی رو داره: about five hours.

words.example: It's raining, but I'm going for a walk anyway.
words.tipFa: اول جمله برای برگشتن به حرف قبلی هم هست: Anyway, as I was saying…

words.example: It's a lovely day. Why don't we have a picnic?
words.tipFa: بعدش فعل ساده میاد: Why don't we go… نه Why don't we going.

words.example: I'm hungry. Let's order a pizza.
words.tipFa: بعدش فعل ساده میاد: Let's go، نه Let's going.
بعدش فعل ing دار میاد: What about going… How about هم همینه.

words.example: Tea or coffee? I don't mind.

words.meaningFa: هر جور خودت بخوای، تصمیمش با تو
words.example: Where shall we eat tonight? It's up to you.
Oh dear! I've left my keys at home.
Sorry, I broke your pen. It doesn't matter, I have another one.
words.tipFa: it doesn't matter، نه it isn't matter.

words.example: You can't come to the wedding? What a pity!
Hurry up! The film starts in five minutes.
Look out! There's a bike behind you!
words.tipFa: برای خطری که همین الان داره اتفاق می‌افته.

words.example: Be careful with that knife. It's very sharp.
words.tipFa: برای توصیه و احتیاط، نه فقط خطر ناگهانی.

words.example: Is this the best kebab in town? Absolutely!
We should leave early. I agree.
words.tipFa: I agree یا I don't agree. ولی I am agree غلطه.

gapQuestions.sentence: Reza and Mina are coming to the party. Who ___ is coming?

___ eat out tonight. I don't want to cook.
Pizza or pasta? ___. Both are fine.
Oh no, I spilled coffee on your book! Don't worry, ___.
The bus leaves in two minutes! ___!
___ when you cross the road. There's a lot of traffic.
___! A ball is flying towards your head!
Ali thinks the lesson was too long, and ___. It was really boring.
